name: Bhairavgad Fort
description: Bhairavgad Fort in the Malshej Ghat region is a wild and remote hill fort known for its dense forest trails, steep climbs, and a massive natural cave at the summit that can accommodate over 40 people. It is one of the most adventurous treks in Maharashtra, especially during monsoon when waterfalls surround the fort.

routes.name: Moroshi Route (Main)
routes.description: The trek starts through farmland and enters dense forest, followed by steep rocky patches and a final climb to the cave.

landmarks.name: Bhairavgad Cave
landmarks.description: Massive natural cave capable of sheltering 40+ people.
landmarks.historicalSignificance: Used as shelter by trekkers and ancient inhabitants.

landmarks.name: Bhairavnath Temple
landmarks.description: Small temple dedicated to Lord Bhairavnath inside the cave.

landmarks.description: Panoramic views of Malshej Ghat and surrounding mountains.
